definition.sourceWork: Resident Evil (1996) — Spencer Mansion dining room
definition.sourceScene: Manoir Spencer — salle à manger, pendule de la grande horloge
definition.sceneEvidence: The dining-room grandfather clock is a mansion puzzle prop. Its unlabelled hands stay fixed as authored composition, not a verified puzzle solution; only its pendulum moves without changing game state.

stage.name: Manoir Spencer — salle à manger, pendule de la grande horloge

definition.sourceScene: Black Mesa — chambre d’essai du secteur C, rotor du spectromètre
definition.sceneEvidence: The anti-mass spectrometer has a rotating mechanical assembly in the test chamber. This loop shows its machinery, with no resonance beam, Xen aperture or attack.

stage.name: Black Mesa — chambre d’essai du secteur C, rotor du spectromètre

definition.sourceScene: Black Mesa — voie de transit, wagon du tram sur le rail éloigné
definition.sceneEvidence: The opening tram travels through Black Mesa; the distant car follows a fixed backdrop rail and never becomes a platform or collider.

stage.name: Black Mesa — voie de transit, wagon du tram sur le rail éloigné

definition.sourceScene: Rapture — station de bathysphère, treuil et aiguille de pression
definition.sceneEvidence: Bathyspheres connect stations in Rapture. The cable, winch and pressure gauge are a decorative mechanical interpretation; no transport or pressure damage is simulated.

stage.name: Rapture — station de bathysphère, treuil et aiguille de pression

definition.sourceScene: Hephaestus — régulateurs mécaniques du cœur énergétique de Rapture
definition.sceneEvidence: Hephaestus contains Rapture’s power core and industrial machinery. The regulator cycle is authored from that function, not a claimed exact original machine cycle.

stage.name: Hephaestus — régulateurs mécaniques du cœur énergétique de Rapture

definition.sourceScene: Lac Toluca — barque de la traversée et sillage lointain
definition.sceneEvidence: James crosses Toluca Lake by rowing boat. The small distant hull and directional wake refer to that crossing, not a generic fog animation.

stage.name: Lac Toluca — barque de la traversée et sillage lointain

definition.sourceWork: Silent Hill 3 — Lakeside Amusement Park carousel
definition.sourceScene: Lakeside Amusement Park — rotation du carrousel au plan éloigné
definition.sceneEvidence: The carousel is a location in Silent Hill 3. Only a distant canopy, poles and moving horse silhouettes are drawn; no boss, damage or combat trigger is added.

stage.name: Lakeside Amusement Park — rotation du carrousel au plan éloigné

definition.sourceScene: Nostromo — salle MU/TH/UR, séquence des panneaux de relais
definition.sceneEvidence: The MU/TH/UR room is lined with illuminated relay panels. The authored sequence uses those panels rather than Matrix code or a hologram from another continuity.

stage.name: Nostromo — salle MU/TH/UR, séquence des panneaux de relais

definition.sourceScene: Nostromo — sas technique, vérins de porte et indicateur de pression
definition.sceneEvidence: Alien uses mechanical airlocks and retro control hardware. A sealed background door and its piston cycle are decorative; they do not open a route or affect oxygen.

stage.name: Nostromo — sas technique, vérins de porte et indicateur de pression

definition.sourceScene: Jungle de Dutch — cascade de la fuite, rideau d’eau et lianes
definition.sceneEvidence: Dutch reaches the waterfall during his escape. Water streaks descend within a narrow fall while nearby vines sway; no Yautja energy, Maya portal or creature is invented.

stage.name: Jungle de Dutch — cascade de la fuite, rideau d’eau et lianes

definition.sourceScene: Jungle de Dutch — préparation des cordages et du contrepoids suspendu
definition.sceneEvidence: Dutch rigs rope-and-log traps during his preparation montage. This distant counterweight only sways while suspended: it never releases, strikes or becomes a stage hazard.

stage.name: Jungle de Dutch — préparation des cordages et du contrepoids suspendu

definition.sourceWork: The Terminator (1984) — Los Angeles 2029 Future War
definition.sourceScene: Los Angeles 2029 — projecteur du HK aérien derrière les ruines
definition.sceneEvidence: The Future War depicts aerial Hunter-Killers sweeping the ruins. The beam scans a backdrop wall only; it has no detection, target lock, weapon fire or damage.

stage.name: Los Angeles 2029 — projecteur du HK aérien derrière les ruines

definition.sourceScene: Usine automatisée — vérins de la presse hydraulique du plan arrière
definition.sceneEvidence: The finale takes place around an automated hydraulic press. Only a distant empty machine moves within its housing; the playable floor and actors are unaffected.

stage.name: Usine automatisée — vérins de la presse hydraulique du plan arrière

definition.sourceWork: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) — Green Hill Zone
definition.sourceScene: Green Hill Zone — tournesols animés et palmes au bord du lagon
definition.sceneEvidence: Green Hill has animated flowers, palms, checkerboard terrain and water. The flower heads rotate beside segmented palms; no rings, springs or collision objects are spawned.

stage.name: Green Hill Zone — tournesols animés et palmes au bord du lagon

definition.sourceWork: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) — Scrap Brain Zone
definition.sourceScene: Scrap Brain Zone — engrenages et bande transporteuse derrière la grille
definition.sceneEvidence: Scrap Brain is an industrial zone with conveyor machinery. The decorative belt is behind a fixed grille and cannot move actors or add an obstacle.

stage.name: Scrap Brain Zone — engrenages et bande transporteuse derrière la grille

definition.sourceWork: Back to the Future (1985) — Hill Valley clock tower in 1955 before the strike
definition.sourceScene: Hill Valley 1955 — engrenages de l’horloge avant la foudre de 22 h 04
definition.sceneEvidence: The tower works before the 1955 lightning strike and remains stopped afterwards. The selected hands stay at 10:03 while the pre-strike escapement moves; a concrete post-strike or 1985 stopped-clock scene never selects this mechanism.

stage.name: Hill Valley 1955 — engrenages de l’horloge avant la foudre de 22 h 04

definition.sourceWork: Back to the Future (1985) — Doc Brown’s garage and DeLorean time circuits
definition.sourceScene: Atelier de Doc — trois branches lumineuses du convecteur temporel
definition.sceneEvidence: The flux capacitor is the Y-shaped illuminated component of Doc’s time machine. This background workbench view animates its three branches without a portal, car movement or time travel.

stage.name: Atelier de Doc — trois branches lumineuses du convecteur temporel

definition.sourceWork: Dino Crisis (1999) — Ibis Island Third Energy reactor
definition.sourceScene: Île Ibis — chambre du réacteur Third Energy, bagues de régulation
definition.sceneEvidence: The Ibis facility houses the Third Energy reactor. The contained hardware and regulator lamps cycle only; no time vortex, dinosaur spawn or discharge is added.

stage.name: Île Ibis — chambre du réacteur Third Energy, bagues de régulation

definition.sourceWork: Dino Crisis (1999) — Ibis Island facility perimeter
definition.sourceScene: Île Ibis — périmètre du complexe, gyrophares des postes de contrôle
definition.sceneEvidence: The local Ibis exterior backdrop has red checkpoint lamps. Their rotating reflectors are an authored animation of those fixtures, without activating the depicted fence as a gameplay hazard.

stage.name: Île Ibis — périmètre du complexe, gyrophares des postes de contrôle

definition.sourceScene: Hadley’s Hope — salle des opérations, affichage tactique de la colonie
definition.sceneEvidence: The Marines coordinate from the colony operations room and consult tactical information. The display is a fixed scene prop, not an enemy detector connected to game entities.

stage.name: Hadley’s Hope — salle des opérations, affichage tactique de la colonie

definition.sourceScene: Processeur atmosphérique — vannes et jauges sur les conduites extérieures
definition.sceneEvidence: The colony’s atmosphere processor is a large industrial installation. Small gauge needles and valve handwheels are authored from that mechanical function; no meltdown, countdown or explosion is triggered.

stage.name: Processeur atmosphérique — vannes et jauges sur les conduites extérieures

definition.sourceScene: Fiorina 161 — fonderie, palan de la poche au-dessus des fours
definition.sceneEvidence: The leadworks finale uses industrial hoists, furnaces and molten lead. A small empty ladle moves only along the upper background rail and never pours or crosses the combat lane.

stage.name: Fiorina 161 — fonderie, palan de la poche au-dessus des fours

definition.sourceScene: Fiorina 161 — arrosage de refroidissement du moule derrière la passerelle
definition.sceneEvidence: Cooling water is released above the lead mold in the film’s finale. Only small distant water strands are drawn here; temperature, lead, actors and damage have no simulation.

stage.name: Fiorina 161 — arrosage de refroidissement du moule derrière la passerelle
